title: Session directory block
description:
As a bot, I want to see which sessions I can connect the user to, so that I can hand off without a listing tool.

Feature: Session directory block
  Scenario: The directory appears in model context
    Given sessions /ops/deploy and /research/pricing
    When a model call is assembled
    Then the context lists path, bot and purpose for each permitted session

Open: size limit, and when a search tool is needed.
right_now_summary: The session directory design is being refined, with size limits and search needs still under review.
